purpose: Record the fixed-but-arbitrary-H2 semantic repairs completed before the manifold-dependent H2 refactor.

reference.work: Ying Hong Tham, On the Category of Boundary Values in the Extended Crane-Yetter TQFT
interpretation_used: A primal 4-handle contributes one factor D.
Each primal 3-handle contributes one factor D^-1.
A special dotted 1-handle uses the plain tensor-unit projector and carries no additional D factor.

semantic_repairs.name: special_dotted_cut
semantic_repairs.before: globalDimension multiplied by the tensor-unit projector

semantic_repairs.name: one_two_cancellation
semantic_repairs.before: the special cut pair was treated as contributing globalDimension
semantic_repairs.after: the special cut pair contributes one; h3 is unchanged

semantic_repairs.name: two_three_cancellation
semantic_repairs.before: the raw globalDimension factor was cancelled through the legacy profile
semantic_repairs.after: the raw globalDimension factor cancels the added h3 denominator directly

semantic_repairs.name: legacy_modular_calibration
semantic_repairs.before: claimed the special dotted operator equals modular Kirby encircling
semantic_repairs.after: deleted from the premodular mainline because modular encircling is D times the unit projector

established: For one arbitrary fixed additive commutative group H2, the corrected role-aware evaluator has the independently specified dotted-cut and normalization formulas.
Representative independence compiles for that fixed H2.
All eight role-aware local move equalities compile with the corrected evaluator.
not_established: A public family specialized to each manifold X with its actual group H2(X).
The full implementation bridge to the independently pinned manifold-dependent semantics.
A four-manifold invariant theorem for all closed oriented smooth four-manifolds.
Compatibility of legacy modular numerical artifacts with the corrected role-aware evaluator.

remaining_root_blocker.required: Replace the one-global-H2 presentation/evaluation API by a family specialized at each X and H2(X).
remaining_root_blocker.forbidden_shortcut: Do not identify every H2(X) with Z and do not weaken the independent semantic specification.
